title: Split five more linux_configuration single_use scripts
objective: Bring install_unreal_mcp.sh (395), diagnose_arch_performance.sh (377), setup_local_llm.sh (370), repo_to_study.sh (365) and setup_dwm.sh (359) under the 250-line cap.
acceptance_criteria: All five entry scripts and all six new libs are at most 250 lines.
bash -n and shellcheck pass on every touched file, with no new suppression and no shellcheck disable directive.
The stubbed run reports every moved function as defined, for all five scripts.
Each entry script still declares SCRIPT_DIR exactly once.
No script is executed. These install packages, write systemd and Ollama config, and build dwm from source.
The unchecked cd exposed in the repo_to_study steps is fixed rather than suppressed.
out_of_scope: Executing any install or diagnostic step.
fix_arch_performance.sh, a different file that is over the cap but was not touched here.
Changing what any script does when run, beyond the cd guard.
verifier: scratchpad/verify_split.sh per script (bash -n + shellcheck -x + stubbed run), plus check_file_length.sh showing none of the eleven files, plus pre-commit run --files and the real git commit for jscpd.
